subject: SIG: Subprocessor summary & evidence timeline for BrightWave Health
messages:
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
From: Sam Liu <sam.liu@brightwavehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Subject: SIG request — subprocessor/3rd-party inventory and timeline

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — BrightWave's security team has a couple of follow-ups while we complete our procurement checklist. Can you provide a consolidated list of subprocessors (cloud providers, telemetry, customer support vendors, and managed services) that Redwood uses for hosted and dedicated offerings?

Specifically we need:
- legal entity name + country
- contact / contract owner (email)
- data types processed (telemetry, logs, PII, embeddings)
- encryption at-rest? (Y/N)
- evidence or artifacts (SOC 2, ISO, or attestations) and a suggested timeline for delivery

We'd like the initial inventory within 3 business days and any evidence indexed by next Tuesday (2027-02-23). If something will take longer, please flag it and provide an interim mitigation note.

Thanks,
Sam
Security Operations
BrightWave Health

Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 08:35:00 -0800
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Liu <sam.liu@brightwavehealth.com>
Subject: Re: SIG request — subprocessor/3rd-party inventory and timeline

Team — Sam from BrightWave asked for a consolidated subprocessor list + evidence index. Quick plan:

1) Markus: pull cloud infra suppliers (GCP/Azure regions, account IDs) and encryption attestations; attach SOC/ISO pages.
2) Karthik: telemetry vendors — which telemetry endpoints receive non-production/staging vs. prod, and what telemetry is redacted.
3) Marissa: support and managed services (Zendesk partner, payments gateway) + contract owner emails.

I'll compile into one CSV and a short evidence index (sheet links). BrightWave wants inventory in 3 business days (EOD Thu 2027-02-18) and evidence by Tue 2027-02-23. If any vendor needs legal approval to share artifacts, call it out.

Please start a column for "estimated delivery" and one for "blocking reason". Looping Sam so he sees the timeline.

— Jonas
Senior Solutions
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 11:02:00 -0800
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Liu <sam.liu@brightwavehealth.com>
Subject: Re: SIG request — subprocessor/3rd-party inventory and timeline

On Wed, Feb 17, 2027 at 10:20 AM Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — Sam from BrightWave asked for a consolidated subprocessor list + evidence index.

Attached is the first pass: subprocessor_inventory_20270214.csv and a telemetry/dataflow diagram PDF. Highlights:
- Cloud: Google Cloud (us-west3) — service account owners: infra@redwood.com; encryption at rest: AES-256 default; evidence: GCP ISO27001 page + internal attestation (will attach SOC 2 report link pending legal). Estimated delivery for SOC 2 excerpt: 2027-02-22 (legal check).
- Object store: Wasabi/S3 compatible partner for backups — limited to encrypted snapshots; some contract pages redacted (needs procurement sign-off). Est. delivery: 2027-02-25.
- Telemetry: Honeycomb (prod sampling) & Datadog (infra metrics) — telemetry includes request latencies, anonymized stack traces, no user PII in telemetry pipelines. Evidence: vendor security pages provided in sheet.
- Support: Zendesk (support tickets) — support staff have no direct access to logs beyond ticket id; Zendesk provides SOC/ISO links.

I've flagged the Wasabi backup paperwork as needing procurement approval to share. Marissa — can you follow up with procurement on that contract? Karthik — confirm telemetry PII posture (sampled traces) and whether we need to redact embeddings in Honeycomb snapshots.

Attachments: subprocessor_inventory_20270214.csv; dataflow_telemetry_diagram.pdf

Markus
Head of Cloud Ops
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 14:05:00 -0800
From: Sam Liu <sam.liu@brightwavehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: SIG request — subprocessor/3rd-party inventory and timeline

Hi Jonas / team,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments — the CSV gives a lot of what we need. A few follow-ups before we close the SIG:

1) Can you confirm whether embeddings stored in backups are encrypted with a customer-specific key or a platform-wide key? If the former, please indicate KMS provider and who holds the key.
2) For telemetry traces that include request payload hashes — can you confirm these are one-way hashes and not reversible; and which environment those traces live in?
3) We see Wasabi noted — given our data residency constraints, can you confirm which legal entity governs that contract?

If you can provide short evidence snippets (one-paragraph) for each flagged vendor and an indexed location in the Drive for the SOC/ISO artifacts, we can mark the SIG as complete. BrightWave's procurement is targeting signature by 2027-03-01.

Appreciate the collaboration — Sam
Security Operations
BrightWave Health
